# Inner Flare

> A private period and cycle tracker. No account, no cloud, no network. What you log stays on
> your phone, encrypted at rest.

Log your period, flow, symptoms, and a note in a few taps. Inner Flare shows history on a
calendar and estimates your next period from your own past cycles — plain statistics, shown
with what they're based on. Every health estimate cites a source. Built with Flutter,
Riverpod, and SQLCipher (encrypted SQLite) for local storage.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the app does, screenshots, store links
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): full architecture and developer/agent reference — read this before
  making non-trivial changes
- [BRIEF.md](BRIEF.md): the original product brief
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute code, and the ground rules
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): index of everything else under `docs/`

## Rules that apply to any change, human or agent

- **Fully offline.** No network calls at all, not even opt-in ones (`scripts/check_no_network_code.sh`
  and `scripts/check_no_network_urls.sh` enforce this in CI). Don't add one without discussing
  it first.
- **Feature files are the spec.** Behavior lives in `docs/features/*.feature` (Gherkin) before
  it's built. Update the relevant `.feature` file as part of a behavior change, not after.
- **Cite estimates.** Any health/cycle estimate the app shows must cite its source
  (`citations.feature`).

`docs/marketing/` holds marketing specs and assets, not app behavior — see `docs/features/`
for what the app actually does.
